assignments.name: verdict
assignments.value: Worth a test on a spare Android 14 phone with a cheap model key: scheduled checks, chat summaries, lookups. Not yet on the phone that runs your business accounts: Ask mode sends messages without asking and account bans are possible.

assignments.name: cost
assignments.value: App free (Apache-2.0). You pay your model provider, or use a ChatGPT/xAI/OpenRouter sign-in or a local model.

assignments.name: install
assignments.value: Install the APK from GitHub Releases, pair wireless debugging once in the setup wizard, add a model. Android 12+ for app control, 14+ recommended.
